verdict.rationale: Pigment's finance use-case page says data is "easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports," which suggests actuals could flow in automatically without manual exports. However, no accounting platform is named, and the only connectors listed by name (Notion, Google Drive, Slack) are agent context connectors, not data-ingestion connectors. Missing for 10: named native connectors for QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite, documentation of how actuals sync into the model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
